data.name: Deaf
data.description: You cannot hear and suffer all of the usual penalties for being deafened [%1 penalty on initiative checks, automatically fail Perception checks based on sound, -4 penalty on opposed Perception checks]. You cast all of your spells as if they were modified by the Silent Spell feat. This does not increase their level or casting time.|OracleDeafInitPenalty|PREVARLT:OracleCurseLVL,5

You cannot hear and suffer some of the usual penalties for being deafened [automatically fail Perception checks based on sound, -4 penalty on opposed Perception checks]. You cast all of your spells as if they were modified by the Silent Spell feat. This does not increase their level or casting time. You gain scent, and receive a +3 competence bonus on Perception checks that do not rely upon hearing.|PREVARGTEQ:OracleCurseLVL,10|PREVARLT:OracleCurseLVL,15

You cannot hear and suffer some of the usual penalties for being deafened [automatically fail Perception checks based on sound, -4 penalty on opposed Perception checks]. You cast all of your spells as if they were modified by the Silent Spell feat. This does not increase their level or casting time. You gain tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet, scent, and receive a +3 competence bonus on Perception checks that do not rely upon hearing, and do not receive any initiative penalty for being deaf.|PREVARGTEQ:OracleCurseLVL,15
